research_question: Does the repeated HJ-alpha divergence arise because unrestricted SDF loadings price test assets without pricing the learned traded factors themselves?

loading_estimands.unrestricted_test_asset_hj: Fit SDF loadings to each test-asset family only.
loading_estimands.joint_hj_with_traded_factors: Fit the same HJ objective after appending the model factors to the priced assets.
loading_estimands.strict_factor_self_pricing: Solve E[f f']b=E[f] on validation and apply the frozen loading vector to test assets.

interpretation_rule: If unrestricted HJ improves while factor self-pricing errors are material and self-pricing or joint HJ loses the advantage, classify the earlier HJ-alpha divergence as an estimand inconsistency rather than evidence of a strong traded-factor model.
boundary: No model selection, hyperparameter tuning or sealed-period access. This audit can invalidate earlier HJ comparisons but cannot promote a teacher.
